references.text: Judah's men explain that they came down to bind Samson and hand him over to the Philistines, showing their motive for confronting him.
The three thousand men from Judah give Samson their oath that they will not kill him themselves, as he requested in verse 12.
Philistine rule over Israel explains why Judah's men were willing to hand Samson over to the Philistines.
David makes Saul swear by the Lord, like Samson who asked for an oath to ensure his safety.
Rahab asks the spies to swear by the Lord to secure her family's safety, paralleling Samson's request for an oath.
Jesus was bound and handed over to the authorities, which recalls how Samson was bound and handed over to the Philistines.
